scientific.integrity: The two principal Makeev sources were materially inspected in full open text. Independent semantic and published-literature searches covered inradius, minimum width, ball containment, generator diameter, rhombic-dodecahedron, and regular-simplex aliases. The proof is exact linear algebra; the bundled computation is a regression check only.
limitations: The theorem does not prove Makeev's universal-cover conjecture in dimensions at least four.
It concerns the Euclidean inradius under a diameter bound on the generating simplex, not arbitrary zonotope normalizations.
The stability conclusion controls generator edge lengths but does not provide a zonotope Hausdorff-distance estimate.
The full text of Bezdek's 2000 related extremal paper was not publicly retrieved in the bounded check, leaving a residual historical-overlap risk.

title: Regular simplices uniquely maximize the inradius of Makeev Δ-zonotopes
